name: Ethereal Trapsmith
body:
Ethereal Trapsmith (Su)
Source Mythic Origins pg. 31
As a full-round action, you can expend one use of mythic power to spontaneously create a mechanical trap in any empty space within 30 feet. This trap must be chosen from those listed on pages 420–422 of the Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook (other traps may be allowed at the GM's discretion). The trap's CR can't be higher than your tier, and the trap remains in the place you designate for a number of hours equal to your tier. As long as you have line of sight to a trap that you've summoned with this ability, created through other means, bypassed, or reprogrammed to your benefit, you can trigger that trap as a swift action, no matter your distance to it.
